parameters.query:
INSERT INTO timesheet_entries
  (project, entry_date, description, estimated_hours, week_start, week_end)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
ON CONFLICT (project, entry_date) DO UPDATE SET
  description     = EXCLUDED.description,
  estimated_hours = EXCLUDED.estimated_hours,
  week_start      = EXCLUDED.week_start,
  week_end        = EXCLUDED.week_end
RETURNING id, project, entry_date, estimated_hours;
